trigger: After the primary strength comparison, one alternate mapping/operator gives a near-observed selected B but leaves strong modeled lower-state E2 routes. Test decay completeness explicitly.
parents: lowest two19/2 states; all results retained
final_states: Every lower-energy eigenstate of the same full model with allowed E2 spin; include same-spin and adjacent spins as applicable.

rate_coefficient.attribution: parent/task-declared standard rate convention, not human-supplied

calculation: lambda_E2_gamma=sum_f C_E2*(E_i_model-E_f_model)^5*B(E2;i->f), summing only positive model photon energies; T1/2<=ln2/lambda_E2_gamma for a state following this modeled decay scheme
uncertainty_interpretation: 20ns quoted margin not a complete Gaussian likelihood; no model-error p-value
conditions: This is an upper bound within the specified model decay scheme, not a model-independent experimental lifetime bound.
Experimental comparison remains conditional on matching a modeled19/2 parent to the tentative observed state.
Missing M1, higher multipoles and internal conversion add nonnegative width; they cannot lengthen the lifetime of this unchanged scheme.
Unobserved model final states are predictions, not asserted experimental levels or observational upper limits.
Do not substitute the measured120.1keV energy for every modeled decay or reconstruct the observed strength using absentICC.
output: all14 parent/operator rows, allopen modeledE2branches, strongestbranch, model-only half-life upper bound, ratio to589ns, and conditional E2-only radiative fractions
